themes.title: Far-Right Election Contestation Following Brazilian Runoff Defeat
themes.blurb: Following Flávio Bolsonaro's defeat in the Brazilian runoff, the candidate fled to the United States claiming political persecution and voter fraud. The escape has ignited a diplomatic crisis involving the US administration, while ideological allies across Latin America align along strict factional lines.

countries.name: 🇧🇷 Bolsonarismo / Partido Liberal
countries.note: Flávio Bolsonaro fled to Miami after issuing a public letter claiming election fraud, leaving the Brazilian right divided over leadership.

countries.name: 🇺🇸 MAGA / Trump
countries.note: Donald Trump declared Bolsonaro welcome to remain in the US as Secretary of State Marco Rubio faces fallout and denies direct US involvement in the escape.

countries.name: 🇦🇷 La Libertad Avanza
countries.note: Javier Milei's government maintained silence regarding Lula's victory and rejected requests from Brasilia for explanations.

themes.title: Judicial Crackdowns and Surveillance Targeting the Far-Right
themes.blurb: Right-wing parties in multiple European countries face mounting legal challenges and institutional confrontation. Standoffs over judicial appointments, state surveillance, and accountability measures are driving high-stakes political conflict.

countries.name: 🇵🇱 Prawo i Sprawiedliwość
countries.note: President Karol Nawrocki entered the Constitutional Tribunal during an escalation over suspended judges and accused the government of a court takeover.

countries.name: 🇩🇪 Alternative für Deutschland
countries.note: AfD faces legislative exclusions, scrutiny over internal security leaks, and proposed legal measures in Bavaria to strip AfD academics of teaching roles.

countries.name: 🇫🇷 Rassemblement National
countries.note: RN leaders face sharp criticism from government ministers urging respect for the rule of law following public controversies and violent incidents.

themes.title: National Priority Rhetoric and Hardline Migration Demands
themes.blurb: Right-wing nationalist parties across Europe are intensifying demands for strict migration controls, swift deportations, and the prioritization of native workers and agricultural sectors in public budgets.

countries.name: 🇪🇸 Vox
countries.note: Demanded 'national priority' for Spanish farmers in regional budgets and pushed for the immediate return of unaccompanied migrant minors.

countries.name: 🇬🇧 Reform UK
countries.note: Nigel Farage highlighted English Channel migrant arrivals as a national security disaster while challenging government welfare spending.

countries.name: 🇳🇴 Fremskrittspartiet
countries.note: FrP representatives called for significant halts to immigration to safeguard national integration and domestic welfare systems.

themes.title: Internal Coalition Friction Over Foreign Policy and Media Strategy
themes.blurb: Right-wing nationalist movements face internal fractures over foundational ideological definitions, foreign policy alignments, and tactical media decisions, causing friction between coalition partners and internal party factions.

countries.name: 🇸🇪 Sverigedemokraterna
countries.note: Jimmie Åkesson threatened to purge party members clinging to ethno-nationalist definitions of Swedishness and considered defunding party media channel Riks.

countries.name: 🇮🇹 Fratelli d'Italia / Lega
countries.note: Matteo Salvini's Lega clashed with Giorgia Meloni over military aid to Ukraine and proposed windfall taxes on banking profits.

countries.name: 🇦🇷 La Libertad Avanza
countries.note: Tensions emerged between House Speaker Martín Menem and Security Minister Patricia Bullrich over LLA's future presidential candidacy.

themes.title: Populist Right Momentum Ahead of Elections
themes.blurb: Populist right parties are ramping up campaign machinery, framing themselves as the sole viable alternatives to ruling establishments ahead of upcoming national, regional, and municipal electoral cycles.

countries.name: 🇪🇸 Vox
countries.note: Santiago Abascal presented election candidacies for November 29, positioning Vox as the only true alternative to the left-wing government.

countries.name: 🇮🇹 Fratelli d'Italia / Lega
countries.note: Coalition leaders maneuvered to solidify strong polling leads and resolve municipal candidate selections ahead of 2027 races.

countries.name: 🇭🇺 Fidesz / Tisza
countries.note: Fidesz and Tisza engaged in sharp parliamentary skirmishes over budget plans and constitutional amendments following recent political shifts.

countries.name: 🇦🇷 La Libertad Avanza
countries.note: Javier Milei rallied evangelical bases and promised substantial tax cuts while laying groundwork for the 2027 presidential campaign.
